assumptions.choice: Calculate Donchian Channel upper (dch) and lower (dcl) bands using the highest high and lowest low of the previous N bars (shifted by 1 bar: high(-1), low(-1)).
assumptions.reason: If the current bar high is included in dch[0], close[0] > dch[0] would be mathematically impossible. Using previous bars allows proper breakout detection on bar close.

assumptions.choice: Check if self.data.lines has a 'seasonal' line; if absent, use a custom SeasonalFilter indicator computing math.sin(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.25).
assumptions.reason: Directly fulfills Option A when the data line exists, and falls back to Option B when no external line is provided.

assumptions.choice: Update trailing stop each bar close and execute manual close via self.close() if close[0] breaches trailing_stop.
assumptions.reason: Follows the specification requirement to evaluate and execute manual close when the trailing stop is hit on bar close.

assumptions.choice: Execute self.close() on an opposite confirmed signal.
assumptions.reason: Adheres to canonical default #2 and #3 for exiting positions on opposite signals before evaluating new entry orders on subsequent bars.
